dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent macro-annuli are visible: a large elongated 'O' shape on the upper mid-dorsal region with a high-contrast transition from a dark charcoal exterior to a light grey interior; a smaller, circular 'O' shape positioned posterior-dorsally to the first; and a semi-closed 'C' shape located on the mid-lateral flank. All three exhibit sharp, high-intensity perimeters with irregular, serrated inner boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, high-intensity white and light-grey pixel clusters is concentrated on the cranial and cervical regions. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as randomly distributed, solid-tone speckles, with a lower density of similar clusters observed along the ventral-lateral margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest axis running roughly parallel to the dorsal ridge. Smaller high-intensity blobs on the anterior flank form a series of interconnected triangular patterns extending towards the flipper region.

other_distinctive_markers: An artificial electronic tracking device is attached to the lower posterior lateral flank, consisting of a green rectangular casing, a red central component, and a cylindrical metallic/white power source.
